notes: All dimensions are decoded from each approved WebP; no 640x640 assumption.
Eye and pupil landmarks come from connected dark/chromatic facial components.
Pearl limbs use alpha, luminance and saturation constrained semantic bands.
Primary leaf tips are radial maxima of upper coloured alpha components.
No visible arms; do not synthesize arm regions from side body lobes.
Small arms overlap the body silhouette and need reconstructed shoulder overlap for rotation.
Raised hands and three separated crown leaves change the side/top silhouette.
Five-leaf fan spans nearly the complete alpha width above the head.
Mature arms are broad; the fifth low-right leaf sits close to the head silhouette.
Lateral moon crescents are route ornaments, not arms or crown leaves.
Heart/petal ornaments surround the body and must not be classified as limbs or crown leaves.
Golden wisps and stars enlarge the alpha hull; retarget against semantic regions, not alpha extrema.
Water tail and bubbles enlarge the lower/right hull.
Approved artwork exposes three primary crown leaves although the canonical mature count is five.

tail.notes: Explicit approved-art water-tail region; do not infer from alpha extrema.

warnings: approved art exposes 3/5 primary crown leaves

notes: Detached crystals and aurora wisps enlarge the hull; crystals are not crown leaf controls.
